verdict.rationale: Box's own features show only narrow event-triggered automation. Metadata cascade policies (box-docs-38) automatically apply metadata to content in a folder, and the developer site describes Box AI Extract filling metadata when a PDF lands in an inbox folder (box-docs-12). Webhooks and the event feed (box-docs-7, box-docs-8) only notify developers, who must build the resulting actions themselves, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: a documented user-definable rules/workflow engine (trigger-condition-action builder), breadth of triggerable actions beyond metadata, any detail on how the PDF-extraction flow is configured, independent or hands-on corroboration.
